name: Focus & Regain Energy
description: Focus internal energy and fighting spirit to instantly regain +50% Energy for upcoming attacks.

name: Shadow Strike
description: A blindingly fast physical strike from the shadows. Low cost, reliable damage.

name: Poison Shuriken
description: A shuriken laced with paralytic venom. Deals moderate damage with a high chance of poison.

name: Smoke Veil
description: Vanish into a cloud of chakra smoke. Greatly boosts defense for several turns.

name: Wind Slash
description: A razor blade of compressed wind energy. Never misses.

name: Dragon Fist
description: A devastating punch that hits like a dragon's jaws. Massive damage with a chance to stun.

name: Flame Burst
description: A controlled explosion of pure fire energy. Burns the target, reducing their attack.

name: Power Surge
description: Channel raw energy into your muscles. Dramatically increases attack power.

name: Supernova
description: Ryuu's ultimate — a concentrated blast of flame-force energy. Obliterates everything. High cost, high risk.

name: Iron Guard
description: Reinforce every part of your body with iron will. Massively boosts defense for an extended duration.

name: Petal Storm
description: A swirling hurricane of iron-hard flower petals that slices the enemy over time.

name: Thorn Barrier
description: Summon defensive iron thorns around yourself, lowering damage taken while punishing attackers.

name: Earth Slam
description: Slam the ground with colossal physical force, sending shockwaves through the arena.

name: Thunder Lance
description: A focused spear of lightning that pierces special defenses and shocks the target.

name: Blizzard
description: Unleash an absolute freezing storm upon the battlefield, slowing enemy movement.

name: Arcane Surge
description: Overcharge your magical conductors to vastly boost special attack power.

name: Storm's Eye
description: Sora's ultimate — summon a localized cataclysm that rains lightning and hail simultaneously.

name: Lightning Jab
description: A rapid electified boxing jab. Fast, reliable, and keeps up aggressive momentum.

name: Thunder Clap
description: A concussive shockwave produced by striking gauntlets together. High stun probability.

name: Static Charge
description: Build an electrostatic field over your body, enhancing quick reflexes and combat speed.

name: Thunderstrike
description: Leap high and plunge down like a falling thunderbolt. Massive physical burst.

name: Shadow Step
description: Slip between spatial gaps to evade assaults while setting up a lethal counterstroke.

name: Void Strike
description: An assassination blow struck from a spatial blind spot. Ignores standard defensive postures.

name: Phantom Form
description: Become incorporeal, sharply increasing defense against conventional physical strikes.

name: Dimension Slash
description: Hana's ultimate — carve a permanent rip through spacetime directly through the opponent.

name: Curse Seal
description: Imprint a malignant runic brand onto the enemy's spirit, draining their vitality each turn.

name: Dark Pulse
description: Emit a shuddering shockwave of negative psychic energy that induces terrible lethargy.

name: Hex Shield
description: Erect a dark magical ward that defiles incoming strikes and fortifies overall defense.

name: Forbidden Art
description: Mira's ultimate — a technique banned from all known schools of magic. The most dangerous spell in existence.

name: Reckless Charge
description: Gale hurls himself at the enemy with full force and zero restraint. Massive damage, imperfect accuracy.

name: Cyclone Spin
description: Spin at hurricane speed, raking the target with wind-enhanced strikes and reducing their movement.

name: Berserk Mode
description: Gale discards all self-preservation and enters a pure rage state. Attack skyrockets for 2 turns.

name: Wild Storm
description: Unleash a tempest of wild, uncontrolled energy. Heavy special damage that bypasses careful defense.

name: Rasengan
description: A spinning orb of concentrated wind chakra held in the palm. Grinds into the opponent with high physical impact.

name: Shadow Clone Jutsu
description: Summon solid combat decoys to overwhelm the battlefield and drastically boost speed and evasion.

name: Wind Release: Rasenshuriken
description: A lethal shuriken of high-frequency wind needles that shreds cellular structure, inflicting heavy damage and slow.

name: Kurama Chakra Mode
description: Ignite the golden beast chakra of the Nine-Tails, massively empowering all physical attack statistics.

name: Chidori
description: Concentrate high-voltage lightning into the hand until it screeches like a thousand birds. Pierce defense instantly.

name: Great Fireball Jutsu
description: Exhale a massive sphere of incinerating flame capable of scorching the terrain and burning foes.

name: Mangekyo Sharingan
description: Awaken the ocular visual prowess to predict incoming strikes and amplify combat agility and accuracy.

name: Indra's Arrow
description: Sasuke's ultimate technique — absorb ambient storm chakra to fire an unstoppable bolt of black destruction.

name: Raikiri (Lightning Blade)
description: An evolved, hyper-refined variant of Chidori capable of cleanly shearing through natural lightning bolts.

name: Kamui Warp
description: Use dimensional ocular physics to tear away a section of target coordinates into an isolated void.

name: Earth Release: Mud Wall
description: Erect a solid earthen fortified rampart inscribed with defensive seals to resist incoming enemy assaults.

name: Lightning Hound
description: Form an autonomous wolf of crackling lightning that stubbornly chases down evasive targets.

name: Majestic Destroyer Flame
description: An overwhelming sea of fire that dwarves normal fireball techniques, turning entire landscapes to ash.

name: Perfect Susanoo Cleave
description: Draw the twin titanic chakra swords of the towering Susanoo, splitting mountains with a single swing.

name: Tengai Shinsei (Meteor)
description: Madara's ultimate — summon an orbital celestial asteroid directly down onto the entire combat arena.

name: Limbo: Border Jail
description: Project invisible spatial shadow clones into an adjacent dimension to shield against damage.

name: Gum-Gum Gatling
description: Unleash a breathless barrage of stretching rubber punches that blur into a wall of flying fists.

name: Gear Second
description: Pump blood through rubber vessels to dramatically accelerate metabolic combat speed and power.

name: Gum-Gum Red Hawk
description: Ignite a vulcanized haki punch in tribute to Ace, igniting the target upon supersonic impact.

name: Gear 5: Bajrang Gun
description: Luffy's ultimate Sun God awakening — inflate a fist the size of an island wrapped in Supreme King Haki.

name: Oni Giri (Demon Slash)
description: Cross two swords across the chest with a third in the mouth, cutting across the foe in a high-speed pass.

name: Tori Gari (Bird Hunt)
description: A rising multi-hit aerial slash designed to strike airborne or evasive opponents with surgical precision.

name: 九刀流 Nine-Sword Style: Ashura
description: Project a terrifying spiritual illusion of a six-armed demon god, tripling slashing attack power.

name: Three-Thousand Worlds
description: Zoro's legendary secret technique — rotate two blades like saw blades before rushing through the target.

name: Mouton Shot
description: A lightning-fast acrobatic combination of devastating martial arts kicks targeting critical vitals.

name: Diable Jambe
description: Spin rapidly until friction causes the leg to glow red with infernal heat, igniting enemies on impact.

name: Sky Walk
description: Kick the ambient air itself to maneuver in mid-air, avoiding terrain hazards and boosting speed.

name: Ifrit Jambe: Boeuf Burst
description: Sanji's ultimate — awaken superhuman exosomatic durability to wrap kicks in super-heated blue plasma flames.

name: Thunder Bagua
description: Swung with crushing Conqueror's Haki, this studded spiked war club knocks out emperors instantly.

name: Bolo Breath
description: Transform into an Azure Dragon and spit a miles-long thermal laser blast capable of vaporizing fortresses.

name: Azure Dragon Scales
description: Manifest impenetrable draconic armor scales that turn conventional weaponry and attacks to splinters.

name: Conqueror's Ragnaraku
description: Kaido's ultimate overhead club slam — imbued with black lightning that ruptures the ground.

name: Getsuga Tensho
description: Absorb spiritual pressure into the zanpakuto blade and discharge it as a high-density crescent energy slash.

name: Bankai: Tensa Zangetsu
description: Condense entire spiritual power into a sleek black katana and coat to achieve impossible hypersonic combat speed.

name: Hollow Mask Awakening
description: Don the sinister horned hollow mask to fuse soul reaper powers with immense brute strength.

name: Saigo no Getsuga: Mugetsu
description: Ichigo's ultimate — transform into pure black spiritual darkness itself to deliver an all-consuming slash.

name: Kyoka Suigetsu (Hypnosis)
description: Subject the enemy to complete hypnosis of all five senses, turning their strikes into harmless illusions.

name: Hado #90: Kurohitsugi
description: Summon a towering black obelisk of gravimetric torrents to crush the opponent without recitation.

name: Hogyoku Evolution
description: Invoke the miraculous wishing sphere embedded in the chest to regenerate wounds and elevate special power.

name: Fragor
description: Aizen's ultimate — discharge a highly concentrated purple sphere of destructive divine reiatsu from the wings.

name: Senbonzakura (Scatter)
description: The katana blade dissolves into a thousand microscopic glowing pink blades that shred enemies like rose petals.

name: Senka (Flash Blossom)
description: A rapid flash step directly behind the foe followed by two swift blade thrusts sealing their soul chain.

name: Shunpo (Flash Step)
description: High-speed footwork that traverses vast battlefield distances in a mere blink, raising agility.

name: Bankai: Senkei Gokei
description: Byakuya's ultimate — unite millions of flying swords into an omnidirectional floating sphere that collapses inward.

name: Two-Handed Kendo Cleave
description: Welling up basic martial disciplines, gripping the hilt with both hands multiplies slashing power tenfold.

name: Reiatsu Seal Release
description: Remove the soul-consuming eyepatch, unleashing a titanic golden pillar of unchained killing intent.

name: Shikai: Drink, Nozarashi
description: Transform the blade into a colossal war cleaver capable of effortlessly slicing through meteorites and space.

name: Bankai Demon Roar
description: Zaraki's ultimate — transform into a crimson berserk oni whose cutting reach shears reality itself.
